content.title: Tachycardia noted
content.body: The pulse scan estimated 128/84 mmHg and showed tachycardia at around 72 bpm alongside mild oedema. A normal range sits below 120 over 80. This is a screening signal and not a diagnosis. Please see a doctor within 7 days so they can check you properly with a cuff.
recommendations: Book a cuff check within 7 days.
Note any swelling in your ankles each evening.
